verdict.rationale: Composio's docs repeatedly say sessions and the Composio Connect MCP server reach 1000+ apps, with 1,500+ toolkits listed in llms.txt. By default a session can access every toolkit in the catalog through runtime tool search. A single community report of an Instagram connection failing does not contradict the size of the catalog. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of catalog breadth and per-integration reliability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform

citations.quote: A Composio session gives your agent tool discovery, account connections, and execution across 1000+ apps.
gives your AI agent access to 1000+ apps, including Gmail, Notion, Slack, GitHub, Linear, HubSpot, and Strava, through a single connection
Build and operate agents with authentication, tool discovery, execution, and 1,500+ toolkits
By default, a session has access to every toolkit in the Composio catalog.
